name: Trailer Park Boys: The SwearNet Show
summary: Take three Trailer Park Boys, add one dysfunctional TV network, stir in a bunch of illicit activity and a healthy dose of profanity. Whaddya get? A combo platter of comedy entertainment that will spawn shipping containers of laughter. Welcome to Trailer Park Boys: The SwearNet Show.

name: Norats
summary: During the Civil War, a father and son hide in the Tramuntana mountains from Falangists. A temporary refuge becomes 13 years of flight, survival, and isolation. With help from few and betrayal from others, they try to escape the island.

name: Electro Monolog
summary: A new style; musical tirade. Musician Emre Yusufi and actress Nilperi Şahinkaya interpret monologues from classic theater plays that are still relevant, with a musical tirade.

name: Meta Aşk
summary: Meta Ask, Turkey's first and only platform that offers dating in the Metaverse universe, has turned into a pavilion that forces its employees to consommation in order to gather more members. The chief designer of the company, Günes, is now overwhelmed by this vulgarity. The ruthless CEO Sebnem does not want to leave her side in this critical period.

name: Tuz Biber Stand-Up Special
summary: Türkiye's alternative stand-up comedy club TuzBiber is at GAİN with its diverse cast of comedians.

name: The Takeout with Major Garrett
summary: The Takeout with Major Garrett will present the show's main courses of in-depth interviews and original segments through the lens of the politics of culture and the culture of politics for the modern and on-the-go streaming audience."

name: CBS News 24/7 Primetime
summary: 24/7 Primetime is your essential daily guide to all the stories shaping your world. Anchored by CBS News' Elizabeth Cook, the show delivers the news you need to know.

name: Ellen's Acres
summary: Features a very imaginative five-year-old girl named Ellen who has adventures in a hotel her parents own approximately 40 mi (64 km) from Tonopah, Nevada named the Emerald Acres.

name: 4 Angies
summary: Angel Elementary School where the four girls, Kalamare, Nina, Pui, and Kai-chan all come to school late (mostly due to Nina's uncontrollable dancing to music). Now it is up to the four girls to figure out how to sneak inside the school without being caught by their Headmaster and being punished for being late to class.

name: Princess Natasha
summary: Natasha is the teen-aged princess of the fictional Eastern European country Zoravia, which is consisted of two parts: an old side and a new side. The old side holds all of the country's landmarks while the new side is more technologically advanced.

name: RTL Aktuell
summary: RTL aktuell is the news program on RTL. The main 20-minute edition is broadcast live from Cologne every day at 18:45.

name: RTL Direkt
summary: With its news magazine, RTL attacks ARD's "Tagesthemen" every Monday to Thursday at the same time. And with Jan Hofer (until 2024) and Pinar Atalay, two of the best-known former faces of the ARD news world are also doing this. Above all, studio guests and reporters are to ensure relevance and first-hand information.

name: RTL Danas
summary: News broadcast on RTL Hrvatska

name: RTL Direkt
summary: Croatian late night news that recaps the most prominent political and other popular events of the day.

name: Awakening Lion Dance Girl
summary: Ye Qingqing, born into a lion dance family, was gifted but forbidden to perform due to her gender. Later trained by former Lion King Meng Xingzhou, after a decade she mastered the art. Defying family opposition, she competed wearing the lion head, overcame obstacles, changed traditions, and became the first female Lion King recognized by the martial arts world.

name: The Rise and Fall of Michelle Mone
summary: The rise and spectacular fall of one of the UK's most high-profile businesswoman and member of the House of Lords, Baroness Michelle Mone - from rags to riches to a possible jail term.

name: Not Your Butter Chicken
summary: Celebrating the untold stories of South Asians in Western Canada through the eyes of food and wine expert Shiva Reddy.

name: Ultra Loin
summary: In a house in the Parisian suburbs, nine roommates from overseas live together. They are welcomed by Guillaume, a Reunionese. This year, a documentary will be shot on this roommate like no other...

name: Quiproquo
summary: Giulia, a brilliant but antisocial business lawyer, is abruptly fired. Desperate, she partners with Lykoz, who wants to save his jazz club by bailing his friend Joachim out of prison. The deal? Giulia pleads, Lykoz chats. But all this is temporary... Obviously.

name: Волчий берег
summary: A personal motive leads Moscow police captain Novikov to the province to investigate two seemingly unrelated crimes. Novikov's favorite journalist Eva drowned while swimming in a lake in a remote village in the Pskov region. Her death is recognized as an accident, but Victor believes that she was massacred by those involved in her regular investigation. At the same time, in the vicinity of the village committed a daring raid on the car of a well-known Pskov businessman. The car was delivering a large sum of cash to the settlement. The cashier and two guards accompanying the valuable cargo were killed, and 15 million rubles disappeared without a trace. Investigating the robbery, Novikov realizes that the raid on the cashier and Eva's death are connected. Major Kazantsev, head of the local police department, becomes Novikov's assistant, but his goal is not only to find and punish those responsible, but also to preserve the fragile peace between the villagers and the local Roma community.

name: My Sweet Brother In Law
summary:
Khanh, a university assistant professor, decides to have a one-night stand with a student named Bao, who is about to get married.
Khanh discovers that the bride is his sister.Both will discover how forbidden and disloyal relationships can be when you don't act truthfully.

name: Ølhunden Berit
summary: By day, Tom works in his mother's clothing store, and by night, he trolls the internet with furious and infamous comments. When hackers reveal his identity and expose it to the public, he dresses in women's clothing to escape social persecution. A story about the path from hatred and isolation to intimacy and reconciliation.

name: Liar's Club
summary: Liar's Club features a panel of celebrity guests who offer explanations of obscure or unusual objects. Contestants attempt to determine which explanation is correct in order to win prizes.

name: Jung Yong Hwa's LP Room
summary: Yong Hwa becomes the first talk show host in 16 years... Jung Yong Hwa's golden network jewel box is revealed!!! "Don't just watch it once, watch it ten times"

previousepisode.name: EP.09 Lee Joon & Hwang Kwanghee (feat. Doo-joon)

name: Liar's Club
summary: Two players compete while a celebrity panel of four "liars" describe in detail the purpose of a real but unusual item. The players have to determine which celebrity is telling the truth.

name: Zonz
summary: For Alice, a 17-year-old model student, arriving in the juvenile wing of Dante Prison is a shock. In order to quickly find her ailing mother, she agrees to a dangerous pact: infiltrate a group of young inmates planning an escape. Her goal? To betray them to secure her freedom. But the more she gets to know them, the more attached she becomes. Alice must make a choice: betray her new friends or escape with them.

name: 10 Things I Want to Do Before I Turn 40
summary: Suzume Tōjō is just three months away from turning forty and realizes there's so much he hasn't done with his life! So, he makes a plan: create a private list of things he's always wanted to do and check them off before turning the big four-oh. It's a rather simple list, filled with goals that should be easy to accomplish, like a takoyaki party, enjoying a parfait out in a cafe, and spending his birthday with a lover. Except, that last one comes with a major problem—Tōjō hasn't had a lover in ten years! But when Keishi Tanaka, Tōjō's handsome junior at the company, discovers the secret list, he's determined to help Tōjō check off every single item—starting with the "lover" part!

name: Kita-kun ga Kawai Sugitete ni Amaru no de Sannin de Share-suru Koto ni Shimashita
summary: The shared living arrangement of three men and women who all fall for the irresistibly charming "natural-born angel" Kita-kun, whose mysterious appeal captivates everyone he meets. To avoid adding more rivals in love, the three individuals form the "33% Club", vowing to equally share Kita's love in thirds. As they clash and grow, the three begin to discover what truly matters most in life.

name: Q1 - Ein Hinweis ist falsch
summary: In the quiz show Q1 - Ein Hinweis ist falsch (Q1 - A clue is wrong) two candidates play together as a team and have to demonstrate the right mix of combination, concentration, knowledge and risk. A good education alone is not enough - it also depends on how well they know each other and can assess what the other knows. Together they have to work out the right answers. Everything revolves around clues. First, the topic of the term they are looking for is announced. With the help of four clues, the candidates have to get on the right track - but only three of them are correct. In addition, the course of the game and the moderator work together to ensure that it is not too easy to find the right answer. Wrong clues can lead the team astray. Players receive 100 euros for each correct answer. There is no upper limit, as the game only ends when a team decides to drop out and leave the show with their previous winnings - or if a question is answered incorrectly. In this case, however, the team loses everything it has won up to that point.

name: Trapped in Osaka
summary: In Osaka, two trapped boys, a dark and confined space, their shared struggle, a journey of rescue and mutual redemption.

name: Al Chile
summary: With humor and wit, El Vítor explores the spicy soul of Mexico. More than a fruit, the chile represents identity and challenge. Between laughter, flavors, and fire, Al Chile is a declaration of love for the heat that burns on the plate and in the heart.

name: Nederland in Beweging!
summary: Nederland in Beweging! is a program on Dutch television aimed at stimulating physical activity. The goal of the program is to get people more active. The program focuses mainly on people over fifty.

name: Второй брак
summary: Arina and Borya love each other, they are happy, and they feel good together. Because they left all the most boring, unhappy, sad and difficult things in their first "milk" marriages and entered into a second one. Into a second marriage, where you can be honest, real, and imperfect. In a second marriage, where you can save money on the wedding, because you already know for sure that it won't pay off. A second marriage is not about socks, underpants, mortgages, problems and difficulties. The second marriage is about love! They say there are no perfect relationships, but there are some that you want to tell people about.

name: Белые вороны
summary: About young people who turned their disabilities into content for social networks and became incredibly successful at it.

name: Bondi Band
summary: In prehistoric times a strange pink stone with an imaginable power crashed on Earth. This stone was responsible for the extinction of the dinosaurs, getting buried under the ground for thousands of years. Tony, Laila, Azim, Nina, David and Boris are six friends who live an ordinary life in the city of Vila Tornasol, to discover the plans of the malicious Miss C. Lebrity. Her goal is to dominate the world using the effects of the pink stone, doing everything to remove it from the center of the Earth. Due to this, the kids are chosen by the guard of Vila Tornasol, Peter Solfa, to protect their city from attacks by the villain. The children form the literal "band" of superheroes, and utilize the powers of their magical instruments.

name: Ceasar and Chuy
summary: Ceasar and Chuy attend the East City Vocational Junior College and they interact with other characters in that setting. One of them being Keel Whitay, a professor, and others include their classmates, Jerome, Rosario, and Dhat Ho. Ceasar and Chuy's family names or age are never mentioned on the show, but it is presumed they are in the range of 18 to 24 years old.

name: KodoTsura
summary: Watabe and Nokishita are ordinary elementary school students who live in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan, around 1990. They like to play a popular RPG game or they usually buy the popular chocolate snacks with stickers inside.

previousepisode.name: 勇者たちのジャンカード 後編

name: Ahmed and Salim
summary: Ahmed and Salim are two teenagers living in the Middle East who want to have a normal life playing video games and watching television, but their terrorist father is always forcing them to do jihad, which usually backfires at them at the end of each episode.

name: Les Enfants de la télé
summary: Every Sunday, personalities from the worlds of entertainment, music, cinema and television will gather around Laurence Boccolini to share their childhood memories, their funniest anecdotes and their favorite TV moments.

name: Block 13
summary: Block 13 is a Kuwaiti animated series that follows four boys navigating humorous adventures in their neighborhood and school. Blending South Park-inspired visuals with local culture, the show tackles Gulf societal issues in a lighthearted, family-friendly way.

name: The Samsonadzes
summary: Starring Gela, a family dad from Georgia who works at the local Bank. He lives with his wife Dodo, their children, Gia and Shorena, and their talking parrot, Kote.

name: Oyunlar Holding
summary: Can Bonomo, Can Temiz and Can Sungur will play a number of games and create fun content, along with their topics from the "O Tarz Mı?" podcast.

name: Eee Sonra?
summary: "What Then?" is an interactive series about tactics in the male-female relationship. In the series with Deniz Işın and Sarp Bozkurt in leading roles, two characters who could not find the love they have been searching for yet, just give up and begin to consult different tactic books. We will watch funny and emotional moments of Sarp and Deniz, who ruin their date because of the tactics they read in the book, as they try to know each other. In fact, not only will we watch it, but we will also watch and see how the story goes on with different endings by deciding on the progress of the story thanks to the options we come across.

name: Yalnızım Mesut Bey
summary: Mesut Süre, which has drawn a unique and pioneering path both in the world of humor and in the field of talk shows! Mesut Süre talks to the lonely, about loneliness, the reasons for loneliness, whether loneliness is "sultanism" or "desperation", over the loneliness of his guests - in his own words - "making people laugh like a bear". Every week, three consonant(!) names are guests on Mesut's stage. Faced with three loners, Mesut scrutinizes his guests' stories of loneliness (for example, unsuccessful flirtations, abandonment, deception, etc.)

name: Deneme Çekimi
summary: Kübra, who is trying to hold on to the cinema and television world, sometimes meets with fringe directors who target festivals in her casting auditions; Sometimes it intersects with opportunistic producers aiming for totality. This diversity of test shoots will challenge both his acting and social identity.

name: Dünya Bu
summary: Love, hatred, passion, inconsistency, anger, meatballs, headman, shooting scenes, necessary and unnecessary big movements, the rule of law, the desolate man in the desolate man and many more… Thirty-two different stories, one world, from the creators of KALT and Errands.

name: Kesin Yaşanmıştır
summary: These stories are as real as they are tragicomic. Volkan Oge reveals lived and absurd stories with his guests.

name: El refugio atómico
summary: In a luxury bunker designed to endure any imaginable catastrophe, a group of billionaires is forced to coexist after locking themselves in due to the threat of an unprecedented global conflict. Kimera Underground Park becomes a claustrophobic setting for two families marked by a wound from the past. Isolated underground and with no possibility of escape, they unleash personalities uncovering their most unconfessable secrets. But the most unexpected alliances also emerge. An excessive and surprising emotional X-ray of billionaires living in a golden hole.

name: Doorbell Detectives
summary: Neighbourhood Watch with a digital upgrade! Matt Allwright has gobsmacking stories of crafty crooks and dodgy deliveries caught on camera, and top tips to help make a safer street.

name: Dover 24/7: Britain's Busiest Port
summary:
Dover 24/7: Britain's Busiest Port takes viewers inside one of the UK's most critical transport hubs, the Port of Dover.

The series takes viewers inside some of the key port control centres to meet frontline staff and shine a light on the teamwork, expertise, operational challenges, and crucial minute-by-minute decisions that impact millions around the UK to reveal some of the huge 24/7 operation that keeps the nation's most important transport hub open for business. From the terminal and port control teams to the Port of Dover Police and the ferry and cruise companies, viewers will get to know the individuals keeping the port moving around the clock.

name: The Altruists
summary: The Altruists tells the story of Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison, two hyper-smart, ambitious young idealists who tried to remake the global financial system in the blink of an eye – and then seduced, coaxed and teased each other into stealing $8 billion.

name: Killer Kings
summary: Killer Kings is a ground-breaking blend of true crime and historical documentary, which will vigorously present the case against six formidable Kings who have left an indelible mark on the world. The series will reveal the haunting mitigating factors and introduce conflicting and fresh evidence, ultimately leading to potentially new verdicts concerning these enigmatic men.

name: Mad House
summary: Abby Lee Miller is back and it's not about plastic trophies anymore. Inviting a group of young adult dancers to live with her, she looks to test their abilities with challenges, as they compete for a spot on Abby's new team.

name: Britain Under the Nazis: The Forgotten Occupation
summary:
To mark the 80th anniversary of the eventual Liberation of the Channel Islands, Britain Under the Nazis: The Forgotten Occupation tells the story of one the most controversial periods in WW2 British history, utilising eye-witness accounts from those who lived through it. 

In June 1940 Britain abandoned the Channel Islands to the Nazis. 69,000 islanders were left to live with the enemy, facing an impossible dilemma: to collaborate, resist, or tread a difficult line in between. Their words, drawn from little known diaries, memoirs and letters from both the occupiers and occupied, are brought to life by actors for the first time. Leading historians Gilly Carr and Louise Willmot bring together their meticulous research, including recently unearthed documents that shed fascinating new light on this forgotten period of fascism on British soil.

name: Secrets of Flying Scotsman
summary: The rise and fall and rise again of Flying Scotsman - the first steam train to reach 100mph, capturing a place in the hearts of the nation

name: SpinoGryzi
summary: Involves 6 troublesome kids and a ghost hamster doing something crazy.

name: Zlikavci
summary: A priest/teacher discusses all sort of things with 3 kids in his class.

name: Jonathan Bird's Blue World
summary: family-friendly underwater science/adventure television program which is hosted by underwater cinematographer Jonathan Bird

previousepisode.name: Invasive Species and Deep Sea Exploration

name: El puente de las mentiras
summary: Will you be able to know what is true and what is a lie? Paula Vázquez is in charge of this new contest where four celebrities must be able to trace their own path to cross a bridge. They have to step on the truths and avoid the lies. With each truth, an amount of money is accumulated that increases during the program. But each lie is expensive, reducing half of the money earned up to this point. And when three lies are stepped on, all the money accumulated is lost and also that player will be eliminated. The final prize will go to an NGO. Decisions have to be made within an exciting countdown. A panic button causes the fate of the contestants to change in an unexpected way. Will our well-known contestants be able to recognize the truths and unmask the lies?

name: Hep Taxi !
summary: In the city and in the countryside, during the day and at night, the taxi-driving presenter Jérôme Colin invites a famous personality for a drive, during which the conversation quickly takes on a familiar character.

name: Krimvakta
summary: Former police officer Johnny Brenna and his investigative team must solve the cases the police drop so that the victims can get justice.

name: Zeiglers wunderbare Welt des Fußballs
summary: Soccer is the most beautiful pastime in the world and a game lasts 90 minutes? Wrong, completely wrong. It's not the most beautiful triviality, but the most beautiful trivialities that Arnd Zeigler uses to knit soccer dreams. Funny, sad, bizarre and always a little bit nasty. But who can blame him when there's something to laugh about at the end? And somehow everyone gets a turn. The good guys as well as the bad guys and the Bavarians as well as the Bremeners. Sympathy and antipathy, evenly distributed. Whether on the pitch or behind the scenes, be careful what you say dear soccer gods, Zeigler finds everything.

previousepisode.name: „Finito la Comedia" – die Saison ist Geschichte

name: ROMCON: Who the F**k is Jason Porter?
summary: ROMCON: Who the F**k is Jason Porter? exposes the dark side of dating in one of North America's largest cities. The series follows successful Toronto real estate broker Heather Rovet as she discovers her perfect three-year romance with "Jace" was nothing but a scam. Her live-in boyfriend was actually Jason Porter, a convicted criminal with a history of romantic deception. As Heather discovers and connects with other victims she transforms from heartbroken lover to determined investigator. Heather risks everything to expose his pattern of manipulation and seek justice.

name: Das Match
summary: 20 Austrian celebrities were coached as footballers at a training camp by former Austrian team boss Hans Krankl and his coaching staff. Each week Krankl nominated three candidates, one of whom was voted off the team.

name: Necaxa
summary: Necaxa, a new docuseries from Eva Longoria in partnership with Welcome to Wrexham's Rob McElhenney and Ryan Reynolds, the three of whom are all investors in Aguascalientes, Mexico-based Club Necaxa. The gripping new series chronicling a turbulent and transformational era at the storied Mexican football club and the steadfast supporters who never give up hope arrives this summer.

name: Our Guy in Vietnam
summary: On the 50th anniversary of the end of the Vietnam War, Guy Martin gets on his bike to explore Vietnam's past, present and future.

name: Matt Baker's British Isles
summary: Matt Baker explores our four nations, celebrating the remarkable people and jaw-dropping locations that make up our rich tapestry of life.

name: Было дело. 90-е
summary: The documentary series "Было дело. 90-е" tells about the most resonant and brutal crimes in Kazakhstan that occurred at the end of the 20th century. It was a time of crime, a time of bloodthirsty killers, a time of racketeering.

name: Die Stadtklinik
summary: In a big city hospital in Cologne, also known as the Stadtklinik, doctors and nursing staff battle against medical and human problems on a daily basis. In addition, competition, love affairs and intrigues arise among colleagues. Medical disputes are the order of the day for the doctors at the Stadtklinik, and social controversies are also reflected here, for example in questions of euthanasia.

name: Messiah Superstar
summary: Mockumentary about the (fictional) Eurodance star Thomas Janowski, alias "Messiah", who had his biggest hit in the 1990s. "XTC" stormed the charts and made him famous overnight. Oli P.  is left behind and Sabrina Setlur becomes his girlfriend. But his second song "Sexy Sex" was no longer able to build on this ecstasy. The Eurodance messiah was nothing more than a one-hit wonder. Now, 30 years later, Janowski runs his mother Bettina's restaurant in the most desolate area of Berlin-Wedding. But then he receives an offer to be accompanied by a camera crew for a documentary soap. With the support of his manager Leon, Messiah senses a chance for a comeback. At the same time, he faces a reunion with old acquaintances.

name: Было дело. Советский Казахстан
summary: The project "There Was a Case" is dedicated to high-profile, resonant crimes committed in Kazakhstan between 1940 and 1991. How did the Soviet criminal investigation department fight crime after the war, during the thaw, during the period of "developed socialism" and during the years of "stagnation"?

name: De Oranjezomer
summary: Hélène Hendriks discusses with her guests their perspectives on the news and current events surrounding major sporting events, politics, the entertainment industry, and more.

name: Tertemiz
summary: Faysal and Gülbahar are employees of a private company cleaning up after dark events such as bloody murders and tragic suicides, and they encounter absurd, funny and sometimes heartbreaking situations in the places they clean.

name: Ты меня слышишь?
summary:
Sergey and Anna are the "perfect family." He is a successful architect, she is an artist turned housewife. They have two children: Dimka, 15, and Dasha, 6. One day, Anna is in an accident. She falls into a coma.

At the hospital, Sergey is given her things. In her purse is someone else's phone. Accidentally turning it on, Sergey sees an intimate video. Who was his wife posing for? Rage, confusion, jealousy, and guilt, because Sergey himself is not without sin—he's having an affair with a girl from a tattoo parlor.

What went wrong in their marriage? Why did this perfect marriage end in disaster? Again and again, Sergey tries to talk to Anna, who is suspended between life and death.

name: STÖCKL.
summary: In her weekly talk format, Barbara Stöckl brings very different personalities into conversation with each other. Their lives and the big issues of our time come together to form an inspiring whole.

name: Rapport
summary: Rapport is one of Swedish Television's news programs and one of Sweden's largest. It is broadcast every day of the week, with two longer broadcasts at 18:00, 19:30 and a shorter later broadcast on SVT1, on some occasions on SVT2 and on weekdays also two shorter broadcasts at 12:00 and 16:00 on SVT2.

name: De klas van 2000
summary: When Seb breaks the painful news to his daughter Emma that he and her mother are getting a divorce, he has no choice but to tell her the truth. He is attracted to men. The news hits Emma like a bomb. Disbelief and questions arise. In an attempt to understand, he takes his daughter back to the year 2000, where a life-changing childhood love changed his life forever.

name: Kiwi & Cat: Mānawatia a Matariki
summary: It's a starry night but Kiwi and Cat can't sleep. Intrigued by the stars of Matariki, they embark on an adventure into the ngahere.

name: Wild Pyrenees
summary: Immerse yourself in a journey into mountain wildlife. Follows animals at all altitudes: wild cats, bears, and eagles. From the lowlands to the peaks, this lush world remains elusive, with creatures avoiding human presence. Patience and careful investigation are the keys to uncovering the secrets of nature in this majestic, compact group of mountains: the Pyrenees.

previousepisode.name: The Pirate of the Mountains The Bearded Vulture

name: Wilderness Road
summary: Cage and Moon are two unemployed losers who share a seedy flat and spend much of their time in 'The Sun', a run-down pub run by Arch. They also spend a great deal of time trying to avoid the attention of local villains Alan and Keith.

name: Константинополь
summary: After the defeat in the Civil War, the whites flee the country for their lives. Among the refugees, the main character is Sergei Neratov, a broken colonel who lost not only his army in the war, but also his wife and children. Arriving in Constantinople, the principled officer is confronted with a completely alien and often hostile world, like hundreds of other refugees. In order to defend the right of compatriots to a decent life from the local government and the occupation authorities of the Entente, Neratov has to confront first the local bandits, and then the entire occupation authorities of the city.

name: Emoji-nation
summary: A playful and offbeat investigation into the world of emojis: the little ideograms we use in our instant messaging. How did a fun, pop Esperanto go from being a work of art to being an instrument of cultural domination?

name: Wainwright Walks
summary: Julia Bradbury presents a series of walks in the footsteps of author Alfred Wainwright

name: Dag Vreemde Man
summary: In this three-part documentary series, Belgian-Moroccan documentary maker Younes Haidar goes on a road trip through Flanders and Morocco, hoping to discover who the Flemish and Moroccan really are. When he asks actor Zouzou Ben Chikha to read the documentary, the whole story takes a drastic turn.

name: Holy Sh!t
summary: A young woman with Tourette's syndrome has a chance to realise her dream of teaching when she meets the family of her late estranged father.

name: Das 1% Quiz – Wie clever ist Deutschland?
summary: Presenter Jörg Pilawa is looking for the smartest people in Germany. The 100 candidates on the show fight their way to the final question, which only 1% of Germans can answer.

previousepisode.name: Mathematik, Würfelaugen und ein Besuch auf dem Oktoberfest

name: Power Moves with Shaquille O'Neal
summary: In this candid documentary series, NBA legends Shaquille O'Neal and Allen Iverson work to revive Reebok's legacy and find a rising star to rep the brand.

name: La Boîte à secrets
summary: Faustine Bollaert welcomes 3 guests who will relive their greatest personal and professional secrets.

previousepisode.name: Antoine de Caunes, Muriel Robin et David Hallyday

name: Der Schwächste fliegt!
summary: Der Schwächste fliegt! is the German version of the game show The Weakest Link, literally meaning The Weakest one flies.

name: Cómo nos reímos
summary: Cómo nos reímos is an archive program broadcasted by La 2 which shows the trajectory of the best comedians in Spain.

name: Viéndonos
summary: Martes y Trece was a Spanish comedy group (initially a trio and later a duo) formed by Josema Yuste, Millán Salcedo and Fernando Conde, which has marked an era in the history of humor in Spain. Their style is characterized by their grotesque gags about everyday life and caricatures of famous people. The audience success of their New Year's Eve specials led TVE to give them their own weekly program, Viéndonos, which combined performances with sketches by the comedy duo. It had an irregular success, with eighteen broadcasts. In that program they did a surreal interview with Madonna in 1992.

name: Lume
summary: Wildfires ravage a village on the Galicia-Portugal border. Journalist Lucía investigates, uncovering truths hidden by the destructive blaze as her probe becomes personal.

name: Adnight Show
summary: Marcelo Adnet receives a special guest who participates in unusual interviews, challenges and games.

previousepisode.name: Anitta, Gui Santana e Ana Furtado

name: Don't
summary: Staring down the barrel of turning 30, the big questions about life goals - marriage, kids & home ownership - have ambushed Bubbah's sleep, twisting her dreams! Can her comedian friends help get some answers?

name: Transformers: Cyberworld
summary: Join Optimus Prime, Bumblebee, Elita-1, Megatron, Grimlock, and more as they're hurled into the hostile and unknown landscapes of CYBERWORLD. Stranded, disoriented and with no memory of how they got there, they must face a gauntlet of extreme, game-like challenges designed to test their strength, skill and level up as they are pushed to their limit.

previousepisode.name: For the Win III: For Cyberworld

name: Los sin nombre
summary:
Claudia, a woman who traumatic loses her daughter Ángela, only to discover, years later, just as she begins to recover, that her daughter may still be alive. "Mom, it's me, Ángela. Please, come find me!" This is the shocking phrase Claudia hears on the phone, giving her hope.

Claudia then turns to Salazar, the inspector who led the case after the disappearance, and to Laura, the young woman whose life Ángela, a special girl with a strange gift, saved after a serious car accident. Together, they follow the little girl's trail through mysterious places that hide a terrifying truth.

name: The Office: Superfan Episodes
summary: Bears. Beets. Battlestar Galactica. From Scranton to Stamford and back, employees plod along at Dunder Mifflin. Featuring extended episodes with new bonus scenes.

name: BeddyByes
summary:
It's not every day we are telling everyone about a show that could put you to sleep, but BeddyByes is different. The new RTÉjr animation is all about helping parents and caregivers win the bedtime battle.

BeddyByes, narrated by Dawn French, sees best friends MeMo and BaBa travel across the remarkable Planet BeddyByes, meeting new and familiar faces on their mindful and soothing journey to sleep.

Every night, young viewers embark on magical journeys encountering fantastical, adorable characters uniquely designed to captivate and calm young minds.

name: 1 Man's Treasure
summary: Legendary comedian Ron James decides to give up his life as a stand-up comedian to pursue his true passion as a treasure hunter. With a map he found in an old boat, he is now determined to uncover the long-lost treasure of Oak Island.

name: Aniela
summary: After her wealthy husband leaves her with nothing, a high-society Warsaw snob is forced to use the only survival skills she has left — her sharp wit.

name: 7 Bears
summary: Forget the Seven Dwarfs, here come the Seven Bears! So, watch out Cinderella, Little Red Riding Hood, and Snow White, because this adorable group of furry friends is about to shake up the fairy tales we thought we knew.

previousepisode.name: Les Ours et le Chat botté

name: Swearnet Studios
summary: These are the stories of SwearNet Studios. Its ongoing mission: to create an all-swearing network, to bring joy and laughter to all civilizations, to boldly go where no fucking network has gone before!

name: How We Got Here
summary: A series examining entrepreneurship and technological advances in the U.S.

name: Gary's Magic Fort
summary: Gary's Magic Fort is the enchanted pillow fort home of Gary the Unicorn and a perfectly plush place to help preschoolers navigate the world of emotions.

name: Find My Country House: Australia
summary: Aussie homebuyers who love the tranquillity of country life find their perfect country house out in the Australian bush.

name: Our Medicine
summary: A behind-the-scenes look at the frontline of Australia's strained medical services, shining a light on First Nations professionals working to achieve better health outcomes for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander patients and communities.

name: À la poursuite du rêve glacé
summary: À la poursuite du rêve glacé follows a group of comedians as they attempt to achieve their childhood dream: winning a hockey tournament.

name: Young Guns (Go for It)
summary: Documentary series examining the music and the musical icons of the 80s.

name: The Warehouse Phase
summary: Malachi Moore, or Chi for short, is an overlooked musician who begrudgingly dives into the world of content creation and influencers after Nic P, an infamous rapper and influencer, dies unexpectedly. Chi must learn to balance his love for music, his addiction to stardom, and his desperate search for a mysterious record executive all in the unapologetic pursuit of his ultimate goal; fame.

name: Momentum
summary: Momentum aims to disrupt the sports media space by offering content that resonates with the next generation of sports fans—those who are often underrepresented in traditional sports broadcasting. Hosted by Kat Sasso, a leading sports creator and influencer, Momentum will provide a platform for young women to engage with sports content in an entirely new way—by young women, for young women. The series is sponsored by MECCA M-POWER – MECCA's movement for social change empowering women and girls. In addition to exploring the latest news and developments in the women's sports space, the series will challenge the traditional sports media landscape by also addressing the diverse interests of its target audience—combining discussions on athletics, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle in a way that reflects the multi-dimensional lives of young women.

previousepisode.name: Leading the Charge: Shae & Lil Redefine Para Sport

name: Matices
summary: Matices tells the story of a renowned and charismatic psychiatrist who gathers six of his patients together at a remote winery to complete their treatment with his famous method, which has achieved a very high cure rate among the most complex and difficult-to-manage patients. After an unusual ceremonial tasting, an unexpected turn of events occurs with a fateful ending. Following the arrival of an astute police inspector who takes over the case, the truth is uncovered about the doctor and his patients' traumas.

name: The First Jasmine
summary: Ye Li, the eldest daughter of the Ye family, is married into the dilapidated Prince Ding's manor to wed the wheelchair-bound Prince Mo Xiuyao. On the very same day, Prince Li, Mo Jingli, weds Ye Li's younger sister, Ye Ying. As a descendant of the Lishan lineage, Ye Li was once confined deep in the mountains for eight years. After her marriage, she maintains a facade of tranquility while secretly orchestrating the downfall of every official who once persecuted Lishan one by one. Her covert campaign soon draws the suspicion of her husband, Prince Mo Xiuyao, himself a man bent on revenge. As both pursue their own hidden agendas, a boulder is hurled into the seemingly placid lake of the court. Meanwhile, Prince Li, Mo Jingli, Ye Li's childhood companion, hides behind the unsavory reputation of an "opera-obsessed prince," all the while stirring currents in the shadows and plotting to seize the throne. In the end, Ye Li joins forces with Mo Xiuyao to guide the young emperor into power, crushing the successive schemes of the Marquis of Muyang and Prince Li, and restoring lasting peace to the realm.

name: All-Star Blitz
summary: Merrill Heatter made a game show, not that much different from The Hollywood Squares or Hot Numbers, with host Peter Marshall. Two contestants and four panelists play together to match a word puzzle of six screens and lighted star shapes. A correct match to the question awarded the stars. After each corner of a screen was lit, the screen revealed that part of the phrase. A bonus round, Blitz Bonanza, did something similar but with the lights matched with a wheel to spin. The winning contestant must provide a correct answer from the clues given.

name: Fatal Destination
summary: Vacations unravel into chilling mysteries - from sunlit shores to mountain retreats, revealing the sinister truths beneath paradise.

name: What a Wonderful World
summary: Hangzhou youth Xu Tian, motherless since childhood, believes fervently in parallel worlds. When he passes Bei Jing's near-identical stranger Zhou Tong on the street, he becomes obsessed with finding him. Through a blind date, he meets pragmatic Shi Diandian, who readily joins his search. But fate twists when Zhou Tong crashes en route to his girlfriend Wen Xiaoyao's performance. On this pivotal day, both couples' lives fracture. As Xu Tian and Shi Diandian navigate grief and unexpected connection, they slowly mend each other's emotional wounds. Meanwhile, Wen Xiaoyao channels heartbreak into artistry, ascending as a star ballerina, her career-defining moment born from reciprocal love with Zhou Tong.

name: A Dream Like the True Love
summary: Born into abject poverty, Chen Pan'er is coerced into a brothel by the local magistrate under the pretense of a river god ritual. She makes a daring escape, changes her name to Bao Yin, and sells herself into service to escape her fate. She later crosses paths with Wen Su, the eldest son of the Wen family, who once rescued her, only to discover that he has become the consort of the Princess Royal. Faced with adversity, Bao Yin and Wen Su join forces, carefully navigating the dangers, clearing their names, and ultimately achieving success at the highest level.

name: The Maid
summary: As the disregarded illegitimate daughter of the Duke's household, Shen Yuqing endures relentless cruelty after her mother, Lady Qin, is murdered. Burning for revenge, she disguises herself as Xiyan, a courtesan at Meixiang Pavilion, to approach the powerful Regent Pei Ji. Using charm and wit, she wins his trust and affection. While secretly unraveling conspiracies woven by the Duke's family and the Empress Dowager, she protects her son, Pei Zhao. Together, Xiyan and Pei Ji confront their enemies, surviving life-and-death trials. To shield Xiyan and Zhao, Pei Ji baits their foes into a trap at great personal cost. After his apparent death, Xiyan and her son flee to the borderlands, where she opens a medical clinic. But Pei Ji reappears, having faked his demise, and reunites with his family, finally embracing a peaceful life.

name: Love Lurking
summary: After saving a mysterious drug trafficker known as K, surgeon Gu Nian is dragged into the brutal world of a drug cartel. Forced to bargain with the elusive K, she finds herself drawn to him amidst perilous encounters. To protect her, K sacrifices himself in a fatal confrontation with the drug lord Peng Li, vanishing without a trace. Half a year later, Gu Nian meets Song Qian, K's mirror image, now a cold corporate executive with a fiancée. He denies everything. Heartbroken, Gu Nian leaves. Yet when her pursuit of her mom's killer puts her in the crosshairs, the hostile Song Qian repeatedly saves her, forcing her to uncover his true identity.

name: Ten Years of Unrequited Love
summary: Ten years ago, Lin Miaomiao was forced to break up with Cen Siyuan due to their families' class differences. Now, Cen Siyuan has become the CEO of Kafei Group and is about to marry the actress Su Peipei, while Lin Miaomiao is his mother's right-hand secretary. When a business crisis strikes, the two are thrown together once more. As old truths resurface, so do lingering feelings. They transcend all obstacles and finally mend their broken past.

name: My CEO in Disguise
summary: Gao Feng, the mastermind behind a top financial empire, retreats from the spotlight to work as a delivery driver. Hired by CEO Su Qingyan to pose as her fake husband, he hides a jaw-dropping secret: he's the head of the Junsheng Group! Bound by a paper marriage, Gao Feng covertly uses his real power to rescue his "wife" from crises. Sparks fly between the unlikely pair, and as love quietly blooms, Su Qingyan begins unraveling the truth about the deliveryman……

name: Trivia Trap
summary: Two teams of three contestants compete against each other to answer trivia questions in various formats.

name: Video Village
summary: Two contestants, each accompanied by a "second" (a friend or relative), compete in this life-sized board game.

name: Do Not Watch This Show
summary: Wizz is a pompous blue monster who is stuck in a TV show that he does not want you to watch! Luckily, Wizz's friends help him navigate the hilarious consequences of being the star of a show that he'll do anything to escape.

name: Room to Grow
summary: This inspiring Revry Original docu-series chronicles the lives of LGBTQ+ youth and their families across North America, offering a raw, intimate glimpse into their daily lives as they endeavor to find their identity and a place in their communities.

name: The Roots of Mankind, A Quest for Beginnings
Хочу верить!
summary: "Хочу верить!" is a journalistic attempt to understand the most stunning mysteries of history. A look at the world in which every step poses new questions and requires solutions.

name: Звёзды рулят
summary: Showman Anton Lirnik and his co-host Nika Viper are visited by stars of television, show business and cinema. They will have to pass a series of comedy tests related to driving, and also prove to the whole country that "Stars Rule".

name: Acacias 38
summary: Acacias 38, the address of a stately apartment building where our stories unfold, is set in 1899 and tells the story of a group of maids and the bourgeois families they serve, in a single block in a distinguished neighborhood of a large Spanish city. Two worlds colliding in a universe of crossed lives.

name: Шоу выходного дня
summary: Comedy wars, celebrity guests, stand-up comedy from young dads and those over 30, guitar and accordion battles, hits from an optimistic mom, the anti-intellectual show "Lopata", unexpected bloggers – all this and more in "The Weekend Show".

name: Building Betty & Joan's
summary: Building Betty & Joan's follows David Ian, Kate Dale and Jeremy Topp as they move their Queer Comedy Club from a venue in North London to a permanent, purpose-built home in Elephant and Castle.

name: Mis muertos tristes
summary: Ema, a 60-year-old doctor, can see and hear the dead. She calls them "presences" and has lived her entire life avoiding letting this gift connect her with the suffering of others. But when her niece Julie — a disturbed young woman who can also communicate with the dead, but in a much more intense and sexual manner — arrives at her house, Ema is forced to get involved. What begins as a family reunion turns into a disturbing chain of events that alters the balance between the world of the living and the dead, infecting an entire neighborhood with voices from beyond. As the borders between life, death, and desire blur, Ema will have to confront her past, her daughter, and the ghosts she never let go.

name: Seitenblicke
summary: ORF's daily society magazine: Seitenblicke, Seitenblicke Weekend and Seitenblicke Spezial.

name: Diary of a Junior Doctor
summary: Five junior doctors face life and death decisions daily at New Zealand's biggest and busiest hospital, juggling the demanding nature of long shifts, relationships, exhaustion and ambition.

name: Kankhajura
summary: After serving 14 years for a crime from his youth, Ashu returns to reconnect with his brother Max. As they struggle to rebuild trust, Ashu's dark past and dangerous connections resurface, threatening Max's life and business. A gripping story of family, redemption, and the shadows that never truly fade.

name: Suntiny
summary: Teacher Sun and Nuea, a couple with an age gap, have been living together peacefully—until a major problem arises: Sun starts experiencing erectile dysfunction and can no longer be physically intimate with Nuea. As tension builds in their relationship, Sun turns to "Third," the campus shaman, for help. He receives a mysterious bar of magical soap along with a strict warning: "Never use it with anyone else." But of course, chaos strikes— Nuea ends up joining Sun in a bubble bath filled with that very soap, and in a clumsy moment, their heads knock together... Boom. They switch bodies! Suddenly, Teacher Sun finds himself in the body of a university student, while Nuea wakes up as a respected adult educator. Their lives are turned upside down as they try to navigate each other's worlds, all while having no idea when—or if—they'll ever return to their original bodies.

name: Leviathan
summary: Set in an alternate steampunk past, an Austrian fugitive prince and a Scottish airman in disguise embark on an unexpected quest to prevent a world war.

name: Revenged Love
summary: After Suowei's girlfriend dumps him, he decides to get revenge by seducing her new boyfriend, Chi Cheng! It started as a game, but falling in love was never part of the plan.

name: André Hazes: The Next Chapter
summary: André Hazes was followed by cameras for two years, during perhaps the most difficult period of his life. He is at a crossroads where he struggles with fears and demons. André enters into battle, especially with himself, and that involves some rigorous decisions. We see an extremely vulnerable and honest André. All masks must come off.

name: André Hazes: Crossroads
summary: André Hazes was followed by cameras for two years, during perhaps the most difficult period of his life. He is at a crossroads where he struggles with fears and demons. André enters into battle, especially with himself, and that involves some rigorous decisions. We see an extremely vulnerable and honest André. All masks must come off.

name: 4 Elements: The Water
summary: When Apo Wathinwanit, the heir to the Wathin Group hotel chain, meets a troublemaker, Chonlada, the new receptionist who comes to cause chaos and change the life of a talented female executive who is always focused on work. A relationship full of tricks, between a game of hate and love, which will reach the finish line first?

name: Il baracchino
summary: Il Baracchino, once the coolest comedy club around, is now a drunken, cockroach-infested dive…and it could soon become a Doner Kebab! But Claudia, an aspiring art director, wants to save it: she puts together a ragtag line-up of comedians for an evening that could change everything. Too bad the biggest obstacle is Maurizio, the gruff unicorn owner of the place.

name: The $25,000 Pyramid
summary: Bill Cullen hosted a Weekly First Run Syndication game show from New York City, with Bob Clayton announcing.

name: The Price is Right Tonight
summary: Hosted by legendary comedian and television personality Howie Mandel, The Price Is Right Tonight is a new Canadian series that brings the iconic game show's joyful wins and classic format to a primetime audience.

name: Müge Anlı ile Tatlı Sert
summary: Müge Anlı ile Tatlı Sert (Sweet Hard with Müge Anlı) is a reality and criminal Turkish television program that airs every weekday on atv, hosted by Müge Anlı.

name: Богатые и знаменитые
summary: Divorces, weddings, children, hobbies, vacations and cars, movie roles and concerts, pets and much more from the lives of glamorous and outrageous stars of Russian and foreign cinema and show business - the rich and famous. Together with the correspondents, you will visit all the important parties, fly to the stars' tours and even visit them.

name: Предсказания
summary: Each of the four episodes of the project is dedicated to a specific topic: career and finance; love, family and friendship; health and leisure; planet. The program features active astrologers, tarot readers and numerologists who will present forecasts and recommendations for the next year for each sign of the Zodiac in the most important areas of our lives.

name: Неоплачиваемый отпуск
summary: What should a young married couple do when the wife is on maternity leave and the husband has just lost his job? Of course, look for new opportunities! For example, go on a trip across Russia in a small car and film a show about it.

name: Одни дома
summary: Culinary masterpieces from Valdis Pelsh, funny interviews and original attempts to solve everyday problems.

name: Животные, изменившие мир
summary: The self-produced series will tell viewers about the history of domestication of the most important species for humans. Goats and sheep, cows and horses, chickens and ducks, dogs and cats – now we cannot imagine our lives without these animals, habitually calling them domestic. But it was not always so! Leading experts – biologists, archaeologists, Assyriologists – will tell about the influence of domestication not only on people's lives, but also on world culture and mythology.

name: Ren Jia Cai Bu Shi Huai Nv Ren
Я лечу
summary: Medical students experience their first practical training in a real hospital, where they have to deal with all the vicissitudes of their profession.

name: Our Yorkshire Shop: A Victorian Restoration
summary: Series exploring plans to restore a derelict grocer's shop in Masham, to create an elegant cafe and historic bakery, in a bid to revitalise the town.

name: Murder Most Puzzling
summary:
When a strange murder takes place in the sleepy market town of Bakerbury. The local police are baffled by a crossword puzzle left on the body.

With their case going nowhere, they turn reluctantly to Cora Felton, a recent arrival in Bakerbury; whose fame as the eponymous Puzzle Lady suggests she can help DCI Hooper and the Bakerbury police solve its first murder case. But the eccentric Cora isn't who she claims to be, and as she throws herself into a murder case that has the town's residents baffled, she starts to gather allies and enemies in equal measure.

name: Killer Whale Chronicles
summary:
Orcas are the rulers of the seas. These majestic marine mammals have captured people's hearts through their intelligence and complex family structures. But ever since killer whales started attacking boats off Gibraltar, many people have wondered: Are they threatening us, or are they just trying to play?

Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor narrates, giving the orcas' stories special depth. The two-part documentary shows the specialized hunting strategies and highlights the social intelligence and precise cooperation of the animals. Older family members give the offspring "school lessons" in body control. But the emotional side of the whales also comes into play: how they mourn when a family member dies and how they have fun.

name: Hayat Bilgisi
summary: Having lost her parents in a traffic accident, the idealistic teacher Afet Güçverir traveled all over Anatolia with her younger brother Kerem. Afet Güçverir, who favors creative education rather than rote memorization, has seen various transfers and expulsions and has never forgotten her former colleague and love Tekin Bey, whom she had to leave because he slapped her brother. Years later, she and her brother arrive at Istanbul Rıdvan Kanat High School, their last exile. This transfer will be a new life for Afet Güçverir and the beginning of a long life education for the students.

name: Disinherited
summary: An unexpected inheritance thrusts a pair of scrappy sisters into a world of generational wealth and long-buried crimes.

name: Свой человек
summary: The hero of the film is a successful businessman. And just when Sergey is at the height of his success, his father-in-law suggests that he take another step. But to do this, he has to sacrifice a lot. Sergey refuses the lucrative offer, and his entire well-established life immediately begins to fall apart...

name: Близнецы
summary: The indomitable Fatima roams the cities of Central Asia and Russia, committing one crime after another. She encounters prosecutor Petr Yerozhin, who does not yet know how closely this investigation will intertwine with his own fate. The year is 1986. Young captain Yerozhin, a ladies' man and promising detective, is offered to become an undercover KGB agent. He refuses, ready to work as a loader rather than "snitch" on his comrades. At the same time, in distant Samarkand, Yerozhin's friend, police captain Vakhid Ibragimov, is having trouble getting his family life together. The bizarre interweaving and continuation of these two events serves as the plot of the series. Ibragimov's "daughter", having gone through a long path of shame and humiliation, becomes an indomitable criminal. Vakhid, who has become a big man by this time, is destined to be the first to fall by her hand. Police abuse of power will turn an ordinary slacker Edik Kadkov into a sinister maniac killer. True love will come to Yerozhin at 45, but this will only complicate his investigation. The fast-paced action moves from Central Asia to the Russian hinterland, from regional centers to both Russian capitals, forcing us to admire the positive characters and eagerly await the outcome.

name: Экстренный вызов
summary: «Экстренный вызов» is a screen adaptation of the works by A. Rogov. The film consists of 16 episodes, 4 episodes for each work ("Superfluous Witness", "Doctor Death", "Missing Patient" and "Deadly Diagnosis"). The main character is a doctor at a prestigious private clinic, Vladimir Ladygin. One day, he provides assistance to a victim of a gunshot wound. He extracts a strange plastic capsule from the wounded man's throat, which he decides to keep for now. Two large companies are hunting for the information contained in this capsule. The doctor, who turns out to be an unnecessary witness, is involuntarily drawn into this showdown. Ladygin has no choice but to start his own investigation, which may cost him his life. The detective story is filmed very excitingly and will appeal to fans of the genre.

name: Сходка
summary: In the show "Skhodka" popular bloggers and artists meet their fans face to face. Some ask candid questions, and others answer, even if the questions are mega unpleasant.

previousepisode.name: Первые поцелуи Маши и Роберта до отношений. Герберы

name: Секты
summary: Leaders united people with a powerful idea, people blindly believed in this idea, not even suspecting that they had become members of a sect - pseudo-religious or openly sadistic. They completely obeyed the leaders and were subjected to psychological violence. In a series of documentaries, victims of deception will tell how they ended up in sects.

name: Tall Tales & Murder
summary: The series mixes a Bonnie and Clyde-style adventure of bent cops, kidnapping, underworld fixers, libido-enhancing horse medication bootleggers, and the dilemmas of unconventional heroes and villains with an 8th Century tall tale of monks, Vikings, buried treasure, and a priceless holy book.

name: Tai Zi Fei De Xiu Fu Da Ye
Le dernier des monstres
summary: Thomas Leclerc, a sympathetic and somewhat nerd theologian, finds himself in the face of a complex police investigation. Detective Savard, a friend, asks for his expertise to decode religious symbols left on the bodies of victims of sordid murders. Thomas's intuitive intelligence, as well as his great knowledge, makes it possible to establish a link between crimes and a mysterious group of devotees with a troubled past.

name: Las mil muertes de Nora Dalmasso
summary: This is the untold story of Nora Dalmasso's shocking murder, with exclusive interviews from her husband Marcelo, son Facundo and daughter Valentina.

name: Fırat
summary: Fırat was a Turkish television drama series that aired on Star TV between 1997 and 1998. The lead roles were played by İbrahim Tatlıses, Aydemir Akbaş, Atilla Pakdemir and Gülben Ergen. The series ended with its 34th episode.

name: The truth
summary:
The series main focus is a treasure map that was inherited by Su Zhenyuan from his late father. That same map is also coveted by Lu Rongguang, who was Zhenyuan's business partner.
Meanwhile, Chen Shuxian and Chen Shufen came to Singapore for career opportunities, but their mother, who came with the sisters, was murdered shortly after arrival. Through the subsequent investigation, Shuxian got to know police officer Lu Zhiwei, and Shufen began an intimate relationship with Zhenyuan's son, Alex Su.
Shuxian, meanwhile, discovered that her mother's death may be linked to Zhenyuan, and later became embroiled on Rongguang's plot to get the treasure map.

name: Delitti Privati
summary: The discovery of murdered businessman Marco Pierboni sends shock waves through the small Italian town of Lucca.

name: Onmyo Kaiten Re:Birth Verse
summary: Narihira Takeru is a delinquent who often thinks about Tsukimiya, the girl who appears in his dreams. After an unexpected accident, Takeru finds himself in a parallel universe, and the world that Tsukimiya lives in. When Takeru and Tsukimiya are slain by a monster, he awakens again and realizes he has leapt through time. Now, Takeru must train with Abe Seimei to fight for Tsukimiya's life!

previousepisode.name: Don't Give Up on the Future! I'll Seize the Possibility I've Long Desired

name: Die Macht der Natur
summary: Whether volcanoes, tornadoes, or asteroids, natural disasters are a constant threat. Our only option: Take on the challenges of natural hazards with brilliant engineering. But do we really stand a chance against these constantly worsening forces of nature? Humans and nature compete against each other repeatedly using technology against the vicissitudes of nature. It's a vital, ongoing contest.

name: Bullet/Bullet
summary: Gear works in a junk shop, retrieving stolen goods. One day, he receives a once-in-a-lifetime job.

name: New Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt
summary: On the brink between Heaven and Hell lies the town of Daten City, where sinister spirits known as "Ghosts" feast upon humanity.

previousepisode.name: Heaven Wars: Episode Two - Attack of the Uncle / Heaven Wars: Episode Three - Revenge of the Bitch

name: Only you
summary: Ayla, now a famous singer, faces threats from stalkers and business enemies, leading her to hire Tawan as her bodyguard. As they grow closer, childhood feelings resurface, and Ayla tries to win Tawan's heart with help from friends and Tawan's team. However, they oppose the relationship, setting the stage for a love story challenged by family and society. Can they navigate these obstacles and find their way back to each other?

name: Stranger Things: Tales from '85
summary: In the winter of 1985, snow blankets the town and the horrors of the Upside Down are finally fading. Our heroes Eleven, Mike, Will, Dustin, Lucas, and Max have settled back into a normal life of D&D, snowball fights, and quiet days. But beneath the ice, something terrifying has awakened. Could it be from the Upside Down? From the depths of Hawkins Lab? Or from somewhere else entirely? Our heroes must race to solve this mystery and save Hawkins in this new story set in the Stranger Things universe.

name: Girls and Their Horses
summary: A murder-mystery set in Rancho Santa Fe, California, that follows the newly wealthy Parker family as they aim to position their teenage daughters in the rarified, sometimes deadly world of competitive horse racing.

name: Tiger Lily, quatre femmes dans la vie
summary: In the late 60s, Rita, Rachel, Muriel, and Stéphane formed a rock band called Tiger Lily. Two decades later, after long having put away their guitars, the women look back at their lives.

name: The Beverley Allitt Tapes
summary:
The Beverley Allitt Tapes looks at how in 1993, a shy, unassuming young nurse went on to receive 13 life sentences for the murder, attempted murder and grievous bodily harm of a 13 children which took place during the space of 59 days whilst working on a ward at Grantham and Kesthevan Hospital, Lincolnshire in 1991, making her one of Britain's most notorious female killers. 

The gritty series re-examines her crimes and the impact they had on all those effected. From the investigators who brought her to justice, to the parent whose child had a very lucky escape encounter with Allitt, to the medical professionals seeking legitimate explanations for the inexplicable deaths, through to the impact on the families of the victims, as well as the survivors physically and mentally scarred  by their experiences.

name: Red Bull Ultimate Rush
summary: The ultimate athletes and the ultimate filmmakers paired with Hollywood story telling: Pulitzer Prize-nominee and Hollywood screenwriter Stephen Schiff (Wall Street: Money Never Sleeps, Lolita, True Crime) teams up with the action-sports wizards from MSP and Red Bull Media House to ask the ultimate questions: Why do these athletes do what they do? Why do they risk everything to achieve something as fleeting as a ski line on a remote crag, a momentary descent down a waterfall few have ever seen, or a leap through space between man-made mounds created solely for a leap through space? Chris Davenport, Antoine Montant, Hervé Cerutti, Steve Fisher and other action sports legends join forces with cameramen greats like Scott Gaffney, Dustin Lindgren and Guillaume Tessier to explore the fine line between extreme sport, philosophy and art. Directed by Murray Wais and Steve Winter, this cinematic quest will take you from the Rocky Mountains to Morocco, from Bolivia to China, and from Thailand to Norway, as it gives rise to the most breathtaking stories. Narrated by three time Academy Award-nominee Nick Nolte.

name: Vreme Smrti
summary: The WWI is the focus of the tetralogy novel "Time of Death" by Dobrica Ćosić. It paints a broad picture of time, events, and human fates. Other than members of the Katić family, many historical individuals are among the primary heroes.

name: Les Châteaux de la Loire
summary: Discover the secrets of the Loire Valley châteaux through their history and heritage.

name: Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku
summary: When the intimidating Rintaro meets the open-minded Kaoruko, the unlikely duo grows closer. The issue? Their neighboring high schools hate each other.

name: Powerless
summary:
Powerless is set in the kingdom of Ilya where the Elites reign supreme with their breathtaking powers—and hunt those without. Paedyn Gray, a powerless Ordinary, has spent years scraping by as a thief in the slums, hiding in plain sight after the King had her father executed.

But when she inadvertently saves the life of Prince Kai, the cruel King's second son and designated Ordinary hunter, she is thrust into the kingdom's prestigious Purging Trials — a savage competition promising glory, riches, and a spotlight she has fought her whole life to avoid.

The fascinating yet lethal Prince is dead-set on winning the trials Paedyn can barely hope to survive – but soon the two realize that the biggest challenge they will have to face might just be withstanding the irresistible pull between them, a connection as profound as it is unthinkable…

name: My Safe Zone
summary: Alin and Jane are childhood best friend. They grew up together, living next door to each other. Unbeknownst to Alin, Jane has been secretly harboring feelings for her for a long time. One day, Alin leaves Jane to study abroad. Years later, a broken engagement brings her home, where they face feelings long unspoken.

name: Chhal Kapat - The Deception
summary: When a famous influencer is found dead at her friend's wedding, a cynical cop has to turn over the darkest secrets to find the killer. Will friendship, loyalty, and family survive the interrogation?

name: Most Wanted: Teen Hacker
summary: Most Wanted: Teen Hacker follows the illegal exploits of Finnish hacker Julius Kivimäki, known as Aleksanteri Kivimäki, who rose to infamy after forcing a U.S. passenger plane to make an emergency landing, shutting down PlayStation globally and orchestrating several dangerous SWAT attacks – including one targeting the family of an FBI agent.

name: Wang Ye, Ni Jia Meng Fei Tai Xiao Zhang Le
Rosefinch
summary: It tells a story about three strangers, polarized by profession and personality-collide through a string of ritualistic serial killings. Their investigation peels back layers of deception, exposing the Rosefinch's century-spanning conspiracy.

name: The Awakening
summary: After escaping a brutal prison, 47 arrives in Wangcheng to track down the men who betrayed his father years ago. Along the way, he gets caught between old alliances, deadly pursuers, and an unexpected connection with a woman named Qi Jun.

name: A Fleeting Dream
summary: Lian Xinruo, the wealthy and happy daughter of a prosperous family, experiences a sudden catastrophe that robs her of everything. Her attempts at justice fail, and she is even buried alive, only to be rescued by Pei Yuze, the second master of the Pei family. Determined to uncover the truth and exact revenge, Lian Xinruo returns five years later under the alias of singer Du Youmeng. Together with Pei Yuze, she carefully orchestrates a brilliant and satisfying game of vengeance…

name: Double Fugue
summary: Genius painter Lu Li infiltrates the Shilun Group to uncover the truth behind his parents' brutal murder, drawing close to the company's illegitimate daughter, Qin Yuebai. The two use and tempt each other, joining forces in a calculated partnership. Step by step, they uncover each other's secrets and true identities. From sparring to sincerity, from mutual exploitation to standing side by side through adversity, love gradually heals the imperfections in both their lives.

name: Royal Upstart
summary: After a freak accident transmigrates Xiao Ning into the Great Jing Dynasty as the disgraced live-in son-in-law of the Su family, he revolutionizes the empire with forgotten arts, transforming tea into ambrosia and turning wine into liquid gold. As commoners clamor for his creations, he shatters conventions by founding the realm's first newspaper, rallying geniuses to empower a princess's political asce

name: That Blackfella Show
summary:
Hosted by Australian icon Ernie Dingo, ABC News Breakfast host Bridget Brennan and introducing Isaac Compton as their studio sidekick, it's set to be a big, blak night of entertainment.

The showcase will feature a stellar line up of guests and First Nation stars including Steph Tisdell, Dane Simpson, Abbie Chatfield, Jimmy Barnes, Outback Tom, Barkaa, Kevin Kropinyeri and many more.

Featuring performances of iconic black anthems from the award winning Aboriginal Australian music duo Electric Fields, Maningrida all-female rock band The Ripple Effect Band and ARIA-nominated singer, songwriter, rapper Miss Kaninna.

 

It's loud, it's proud, it's a variety hour not to be missed.

name: Chasing the West
summary:
Before hitting it big ashome renovation and real estate dynamos, Drew and Jonathan Scott spent their childhood on a horse ranch. Now the Brothers will use their background to help buyers with a hankering for adventure find their dream properties

Follow the twin duo as they take families who wish to escape hectic city life or own land discover the incredible attributes and unique challenges of ranch living, including adapting to a slower pace, tending livestock and growing produce. The series will highlight cinematic landscapes with properties in Arizona, California and Texas and find Drew and Jonathan revisiting some ranch-inspired activities like horseback riding, off-roading in ATVs, and the art of lassoing. With the Brothers' help, each set of buyers will feel more prepared to live out their Wild West fantasy lives.

name: Maschek
summary: The television images from all channels, from "Zeit im Bild" to sports, from prime time shows to social media, are analyzed, reinterpreted and brought to the Maschek remix once a month. The television material in the (almost) lip-synced flashback of the two voice anarchos - real fake and cleverly stupid.

name: Fireflies
summary: In a small peaceful desert town, residents mysteriously start spontaneously combusting. Mimi, a mine clearance company instructor, believes these cases are not caused by landmines, but by a phenomenon she experienced in her childhood – where a deep sense of loneliness ignites a deadly inner flame. Along with her childhood friend Dikla, a police officer in the local station, they investigate the spreading phenomenon trying to track down who is behind it and stop them from terrorizing the serene town.

name: Cegin Cyw
summary: There's plenty of fun in the kitchen in this cookery series for young children.

name: PICME
summary:
PICME is an entertaining and educational animated series for a pre-school audience. The unique concept behind PICME is that, from text to graphics, it is completely personalised.

An audience member can literally star in his/her own cartoon show. Created with the help of educational experts to stimulate growing minds, PICME gives children a uniquely engaging learning experience.

The PICME stories enable a child to star in an episode alongside six cute animal friends. Neville the Elephant, Banjo the Monkey, Gerty the Giraffe, Juno the Lion, Clarence the Crocodile and Umi the Parrot. Each character has a different personality and abilities and attributes.

name: Late Check Out
summary: 'Late Check Out', hosted by Ellie Taylor, will follow every episode of the main show on ITVX and as a podcast. Viewers and listeners will be taken on a deep dive into all things Fortune Hotel, with behind-the-scenes gossip, exclusive clips, and interviews with the hotel's freshly checked-out pairs and special guests along the way. 'Late Check Out' will also feature exclusive scenes with Stephen Mangan as he reacts to the dramatic Night Caps, plus there are two special episodes which feature hilarious outtakes from him. Additionally, the vodcast will also showcase ‘The Golden Case reveal', where eliminated pairs discover who was holding the money, with shocks and revelations aplenty. The Fortune Hotel: Late Check Out will go out across ITVX, YouTube & all Global platforms (including Spotify and Apple).

name: CBeebies House: Time to Play
summary: Join in all the fun with your friends in the CBeebies House. Find things to make and do, watch fun clips and sing along with songs and Number Raps.

name: Playtime Towers
summary: Join Bella and Lift on a fun-filled adventure exploring the floors of Playtime Towers. Meet playful friends for singing, dancing, making and laughing. How will you play today?

name: Transaction
summary:
Jordan Gray stars as Liv, a transgender egomaniac, causing havoc in the strange world of the supermarket nightshift.

Having been hired to work there by Pellocks boss Simon after he inadvertently offended the LGBTQ+ community with an ill-conceived marketing campaign, Liv soon realises she's unsackable and sets about turning the store into her own personal playground, unleashing chaos on everyone and everything around her.
